question: If I control Thought Reflection and have four cards in hand, and Damia, Sage of Stone makes me draw until I have seven, do I draw six cards?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: effects can modify the number of cards you draw, so with Thought Reflection you draw six.
expected.answer: Effects can modify the number of cards you’ll draw. For example, if you have four cards in your hand and control Thought Reflection (“If you would draw a card, draw two cards instead.”), you’ll draw six cards.
